relics.name: Power Switch
relics.conditions: Randomises your Lethal and Tactical equipment after each round.

steps.title: Reach Round 20+
steps.body: Start on any tier of Cursed Mode on Totenreich and reach Round 20 .

steps.title: Grab a Scoped Weapon
steps.body: Buy a Sniper from the wall or use the mystery box to get a scoped weapon.

steps.title: Locate the 4 Deer Skull Totems Outside the Map
steps.body:
You have to look at a total of 4 totems and remember how many Deer skulls are attached to each Totem.
  • Eidskallen Landing - Stand opposite Rampage Inducer near barbed wire. The altar sits on the shoreline to the southwest.
  • Core Foundry / Dry Dock - Stand in Dry Dock just before the door to War Factory, look up at the cliff to the west.
  • Tyr's Foot - Stand with your back to Tyr's Foot look northwest toward the mountain.
  • Burial Grounds - From Skallen Market, head northeast and look up at the cliff edge above the Burial Grounds.

steps.title: Throw Axe at Animal Pelts in Viking Hall
steps.body:
Whilst looking into the hall from vultures aid, you will see 4 pelts. Hit each one according to how many deer skulls was on each totem in each location.
  • Front Right - Tyr's Foot
  • Back Right - Burial Grounds
  • Front Left - Core Foundry
  • Back Left - Eidskallen Landing

relics.name: Samantha's Drawing
relics.effect: A scrap of paper still warm from childish hands.
relics.conditions: Your equipped weapons swap to random different weapons every round (maintaining PaP level and rarity).

steps.title: Find Chompy
steps.body: In a Tier I Cursed match, look for Chompy — a trash can that appears in each POI but is only active in one spot at a time. Melee it to open it up.

steps.title: Feed Chompy one weapon of every rarity
steps.body:
Feed weapons in this exact order:
  1. Common — Your starting Jäger 45
  2. Uncommon (green)
  3. Rare (blue)
  4. Epic (purple)
  5. Legendary (orange)
steps.tip: Uncommon and Rare weapons become unobtainable in later rounds — feed them to Chompy early before they disappear.

steps.title: Feed Chompy the Ray Gun on Round 40+
steps.body: On or after Round 40, feed Chompy the Ray Gun or Ray Gun Mark II. This triggers the portal.

steps.title: Start the trial
steps.body: The Relic Portal spawns near Yuri's Lab at Zarya Cosmodrome. Survive 5 waves of zombies and HVTs. Ammo Caches and Max Ammos are disabled for the entire trial.

relics.name: Stuffed Elephant
relics.conditions: Increases the delay before your health starts regenerating after taking damage.

relics.name: Dancing Arnie
relics.conditions: Makes all Perk-a-Colas give random Perk-a-Colas when bought.

steps.title: Start Match with Tier 1 Cursed Mode
steps.body: Start on Tier 1 of Cursed Mode on Totenreich.
steps.tip: Grab the Jotunn Star and prepare to get to round 40 . Round 40 not required until later.

steps.title: Grab The Cooking Pot
steps.body: While inside of Skallen Market , underneath one of the booths, near where the Zursa comes out during the Jotunn Star quest or behind the Mule Kick Perk-a-Cola. You need to pick up the Cooking Pot on the Floor.
steps.tip: Easiest to pickup while laid down.

steps.title: Place The Pot on the Fire Pit
steps.body: Take the Cooking Pot to the Viking Hall and place it on the Fire Pit opposite of Vultures Aid .

steps.title: Grab The Tankard and Add to The Cooking Pot
steps.body: Go to Eidskallen Square , and behind Loven's Antiquities and or the Arsenal you can pickup a Tankard of Ale on top of a barrel. Bring this back to the Cooking Pot and Press Interact to add it to the Cooking Pot .

steps.title: Grab The Chilly Chunks and Add to The Cooking Pot
steps.body: Go to Storm Bridge , and behind the Truck you can pickup the Chilly Chunks . Bring this back to the Cooking Pot and Press Interact to add it to the Cooking Pot .
steps.tip: After you place the Chilly Chunks in the Cooking Pot you can grenade the Truck next to the Chilly Chunks spawn location and get another for the Jotunn Star.
steps.warn: Ensure you do the Chilly Chunks before the wonder weapon. If you do the wonder weapon first you can no longer do this step.

steps.title: Grab The Red Lobster and Add to The Cooking Pot
steps.body: Use the Flammenfalle Fire Trap to fully kill a Necropincer. The Red Lobster will drop from the Necropincer if it deals the finishing blow. Bring this back to the Cooking Pot and Press Interact to add it to the Cooking Pot .

steps.title: Reach Round 40
steps.body: Fight your way through to reach Round 40 .

steps.title: Fish on a Special Round
steps.body: On a Special Round after round 40, you can now fish at Fishery Island to obtain the Red Fish . Bring this back to the Cooking Pot and Press Interact to add it to the Cooking Pot .
steps.tip: Easiest to do at end of the special round.

steps.title: Feed Mr Peeks
steps.body: Once the Red Fish is added, Mr Peeks will spawn on top of the Cooking Pot . Use the Jotunn Star to get kills next to Mr Peeks to feed him.
steps.tip: Takes around 100 souls to fill up Mr Peeks.

steps.title: Enter Relic Trial
steps.body: After Mr Peeks disappears, go to Fishery Island , inside the shop above Pack-a-Punch . The Relic Trial Portal should appear.
steps.tip: Bring the Jotunn Star with Melee Macchiato and Pack-a-Punch tier 3.
steps.warn: Zombies can only be damaged with melee during the trial.

steps.title: Complete the Trial
steps.body: Survive multiple waves of zombies and HVT's and the relic is done.

guides.name: Ashes of the Damned Main Quest
guides.author: community
guides.description: The complete main easter egg quest line. Restore power, collect key items, free Klaus, craft the Necrofluid Gauntlet, and take down the colossal Veytharion.
guides.conditions: Complete all main quest objectives in a single match. Rewards calling card, camo, and lore unlocks.

steps.title: Turn On the Power and Unlock Pack-a-Punch
steps.body: In the Janus Towers Plaza starting area, enter the white building and melee the floor grate to find T.E.D.D.'s Head. Exit west, find the pickup truck outside, and place T.E.D.D.'s Head onto Ol' Tessie.
steps.tip: Pack-a-Punch travels with Ol' Tessie wherever she goes.

steps.title: Exit 115 Diner — Obtain the Abomination Carcass
steps.body: Drive southwest to Exit 115 and buy the doors to Reba's Diner (1,250 Essence). Stay inside until the Cook zombie spawns. Kill him for the Freezer Key, then unlock the freezer.
steps.warn: The Cook only spawns and drops the key while you're inside the diner.

steps.title: Upgrade Ol' Tessie with Abomination Beam
steps.body: Drive back to the Ashwood Garage, park Ol' Tessie inside, and interact with the crafting table. Three abomination heads on the front of the truck now shoot lasers (R1/RB).

steps.title: Capture Kitchen and Training Area Wards
Acquire Shogun's Hanko
steps.body: Kill the Oni that spawns in the War Room and pickup the Shogun's Hanko. Deliver the Hanko into the doorway.
steps.tip: Pickup the green shards and note to the left of the doorway.

steps.title: Feed the World Seed Zombie Souls
Pickup Furin Bell
Pickup Maneki-Neko
Pickup Karakuri
Craft Maneki-Neko
steps.body: Craft the Maneki-Neko toy at the workstation left of Vultures Aid.

steps.title: Collect Cat Cage
steps.body: Using PHD dive into the corner underneath the cat cage, located near Mule Kick and the Tenshu Entrance.

steps.title: Throw Cat Cage into any Lava
steps.tip: This can be done with any lava source

steps.title: Reveal Paw Prints
steps.body: Kill a zombie in one of these locations and see if paw prints will show up. If paw prints show up follow the direction the prints are taking you and kill another zombie until the prints go in a small circle.
steps.warn: Will only spawn in after a round change

steps.title: Throw Maneki-Neko toy in centre of Paw Prints
steps.body: Once circular paw prints have been revealed throw a Maneki-Neko toy into the centre and kill a zombie nearby to spawn the cat. Doing so will cause an abomination to spawn in which you have to kill and progress a round.

steps.title: Capture the Cat
steps.body: Once the cat has been found avoid certain boards to capture the cat.
steps.warn: Use Depth Perception to see noisy boards

steps.title: Bring Cat to World Seed
steps.body: Once at the world seed the Cat will jump onto the seed automatically and start the next step. Once the Seed starts shockwaves, melee the world seed in-between shocks.

steps.title: Pickup Empty Pouch
steps.body: Shoot a charged shot of the wonder weapon above the ammo box in the Training Area on the broken beam jutting outward.

steps.title: Pickup Monkshood Bud
steps.body: Pickup the Monkshood Bud in the Flower Garden next to one of the broken bridges, to the right hand side of the workstation.

steps.title: Fill the Pouch
steps.body: Stand inside of volcanic ash spewed up from fissures that randomly spawn in. Stand inside for around 1 Minute.
steps.warn: You must have the empty pouch before this step

steps.title: Plant the Bud in Tenshu Entrance
steps.body: Place the bud in the flowerpot to the left hand side of the Tenshu Entrance.

steps.title: Melee a Cherry Blossom Tree and Upgrade the plant
steps.body: Melee any Cherry Blossom on the map until you are overhealed. Head back to the plant and run in circles until a tornado appears, this will upgrade the plant and allow you to pick it up.

steps.title: Pickup Plum Pit
steps.body: Head over and look for a small basket of green fruit in the Kitchen Area. Melee them until they drop one of the green fruits on the ground. Jump on-top of the Plum that falls 3 times and pickup the pit.

steps.title: Pickup Pestle
steps.body: Head to the storage Rooms and locate the Scroll Puzzle. interact with the puzzle either with melee or shooting. Push all the scrolls into the wall to win the puzzle and pickup the pestle and note

steps.title: Feed zombie souls to Pestle and Mortar in Kitchen
steps.body: Head to the Kitchen and place the Pestle into the mortar cup. Using a gun with brainrot or using charged up wonderweapon shots fill up the mortar with zombie souls until the pestle turns blue. Interact with this and the a small cutscene will play.
steps.warn: Have to use either brainrot or charged up wonder weapon shot

steps.title: Pickup Pufferfish
steps.body: Once the cutscene is done a small cuboard door will open up close to the mortar in the Kitchen. Pickup the Pufferfish inside.

steps.title: Follow the Mask and Shoot down the mask and collect evidence
Deliver all Evidence so far into the Meditation Room
Interact with Coin purse and water 3 Plants in Flower Garden
Kill Tomato Zombie in Staging Area
Kill the Noble with his own grenades
Deliver the Evidence to the Meditation Room
Deliver the Evidence to the Meditation Room
Repair Sake Cup in Tea Garden
Deliver all Evidence so far into the Meditation Room
Collect Small Statue in Lava
steps.warn: Lava has to be cooled down in rock formation

steps.title: Interact with Clock
steps.body: Near PHD there is a small clock, interact with it and memorise the 4 numbers it flashes.
steps.warn: Next round will be assault round

steps.title: 1st Evidence
steps.body: Always Antique Comb

steps.title: 2nd Evidence
steps.body:
Next, you'll need to figure out the identity of the accomplice. To do this, activate all Ghostly Riflemen Traps on the map until a blue ghost of one of the riflemen appears (near any of the traps). Listen to what they have to say to figure out who the accomplice was.

The ghost will mention one of the following: Gardener, Merchant, or Courtier. The first two are refer to their elite counterparts that you fought earlier. The Courtier refers to the Noble.

steps.title: 3rd Evidence
steps.body:
Head over to the evidence wall and re-read the Death Records note that you got earlier. The type of poison used will depend on what the doctor wrote as the cause of death:
　① Pufferfish: "...contaminated or noxious food and showed signs of emesis."
　② Plum Pit: "...contaminated or noxious plant."
　③ Monkshood Flower: "...showed evidence of paralysis"

Once you've figured out the type of Poison used, pick up the right evidence item then place it in front of the 3rd Portrait.

steps.title: 4th Evidence
steps.body:
The 4th Portrait indicates where the Shogun ingested the poison. To determine which evidence item to place, refer to the guide below:
　① Koi (Fish) Painting: Tea Whisk
　② Mountain Painting: Horse Statuette
　③ Bird Painting: Calligraphy Brush

steps.title: 5th Evidence
steps.body: Always Crest Medallion

steps.title: Time of Death evidence
steps.body:
Since you now know what Poison was used, read the Known Toxins note to figure out the time of poisoning.
　① Pufferfish: 3 hours
　② Plum Pit: 4 hours
　③ Monkshood Flower: 2 hours

Next, re-read the Death Records to determine the time of death. The time will be indicated by an animal (e.g., Hour of the Boar).

With the poison's activation time and time of death figured out, head over to the Zodiac Clock beside the 1st Portrait. Set it to the the correct time indicating when the Shogun was poisoned.

To make it easy, set the Zodiac Clock to match the time of death (e.g., have the dial point to the Boar icon if the Hour of the Boar was the time of death). Then, subtract 2/3/4 places counter-clockwise depending on the poison used.

steps.title: Use the Fast Travel at Pack a Punch to travel to Boss Fight
